pass_1.finding: The predecessor supplement prints A_adapter_t ending GATC*T (terminal phosphorothioate) and A_adapter_b beginning GATC; SHAPE-Seq SI instead prints its own A_adapter_b beginning AGATC and no RT-tail phosphorothioate mark. This is protocol-specific source difference, not a publication error. The surrounding supplement sections on DNA preparation/ligation and sequencing were inspected; read-alignment links at lines 716–725 are irrelevant to SHAPE molecular construct and were not followed. Supplement reference 1 Bentley 2008 (generic Illumina adapter/end repair) and reference 2 Quail 2008 (qPCR) are chemistry-adjacent and added below as linked-source rows; analysis-only SSAHA/Velvet links are irrelevant to the SHAPE molecular construct.

missing_claims.claim: Exact historical GAIIx paired-end sequencing primer sequences are unavailable
missing_claims.evidence: Illumina 11 January 2011 original letter, p. 6, prints PE Read 1 and PE Read 2; the latter reverse-complements to the first 37 bases of the SHAPE-Seq A_adapter_b in defining SI p. 1. The page and model now show this source-supported primer. Run-specific reagent lot remains unspecified and is not asserted missing.

conclusion: Historical sequencing-primer sequence claim resolved by two independent reads of the original 2011 Illumina letter and defining SI pairing. Kozarewa 2009 original manuscript and author-uploaded supplement now have independent original-source reads; their adapter difference is recorded in the SHAPE-Seq note. Mortimer 2009 original RT protocol is still inaccessible for a full read, and Bentley/Quail originals linked by the Kozarewa supplement remain to be inspected, so linked-source review remains blocked. No residual absence claim accepted.
